exercises.question: Which sentence describes a hypothetical consequence? [¿Cuál describe una consecuencia hipotética?]
options: Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If the plan changed, something different would happen.]
El plan de contingencia cambia según las necesidades. [The contingency plan changes according to needs.]
El plan inicial cambió tras la decisión del director. [The initial plan changed following the director's decision.]

exercises.sentence: Si ___, no saldríamos. [If it rained, we would not go out.]
exercises.english: If it rained, we would not go out.
If the plan changed, something different would happen.

sentences: Primero, el equipo piensa en cambiar el plan. [First, the team thinks about changing the plan.]
Después, imagina qué ocurriría. [Then it imagines what would happen.]
Finalmente, concluye: «Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente». [Finally, it concludes: “If the plan changed, something different would happen.”]

options: consecuencia [consequence]
resultado [result]

exercises.sentence: Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente.
options: If the plan changed, something different would happen.
The plan changed and something happened.
The plan will change tomorrow.
If it rained, we would not go out.
If it rains, we do not go out.
It rained, so we did not go out.

options: Ocurriría algo diferente. [Something different would happen.]
Ocurra algo diferente. [Something different happens (subjunctive).]
Ocurre algo diferente ahora. [Something different is happening now.]
El resultado sería diferente. [The result would be different.]
El resultado sea diferente. [The result is (subjunctive) different.]

No saliríamos. [We would not go out.]
No salgamos. [We do not go out (subjunctive).]
